question: Should session-memory broaden duplicate filtering from delivery-mirror rows to all duplicate transcript-only OpenClaw assistant rows, including `gateway-injected`?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes which persisted assistant transcript rows are recalled into generated memory, so CI cannot settle the session-state product risk.

options.title: Accept guarded gateway-injected dedupe
options.body: Merge this PR after required checks because it only drops duplicate transcript-only rows and preserves unique `gateway-injected` and `delivery-mirror` text.

options.title: Request a stricter guard
options.body: Ask for an ACP-runtime-specific or metadata-specific gateway-injected predicate if maintainers want a narrower projection than the shared transcript-only helper.

options.title: Keep delivery-mirror only
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want session-memory to retain all `gateway-injected` rows even when they duplicate the previous assistant reply.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded gateway-injected dedupe
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after required checks because it only drops duplicate transcript-only rows and preserves unique `gateway-injected` and `delivery-mirror` text.

likelyOwner.reason: They accepted the same session-memory projection risk on the merged sibling and pushed the final edge-case commit there.
